criteria.title: Phone Line Setup & Basic Interaction
criteria: Dedicated phone number is callable and answers within 2 rings
Initial greeting plays with consent disclosure
Voice sounds natural and warm (not robotic)
System responds to basic greetings appropriately

criteria.title: Interruption Handling
criteria: Assistant stops speaking within 200ms when interrupted
No audio overlap or echo during interruptions

criteria.title: Task 1: Ticket Creation
criteria: Assistant can gather issue description accurately
Ticket appears in CRM within 5 seconds

criteria.title: Task 2: Appointment Scheduling
criteria: Sends confirmation to customer's preferred channel

criteria.title: Call Summary Generation
criteria: Summary sent within 2 minutes of call end
Includes key points and actions taken

criteria.title: Privacy & Consent
criteria: Consent line plays for 100% of calls
PII redaction works for names, numbers, addresses
Audit log captures all data access

criteria.title: Human Handoff
criteria: Recognizes when to escalate to human
Provides context to human agent via screen-pop
Fallback number provided if transfer fails
